description: The source describes individual accidents on three Croatian roads, with 2022–2025 in the native title. One sheet contains road/section/chainage and GPS fields, dates, accident types, road and surface conditions, vehicle characteristics, participant outcomes and data-quality flags. These observations provide a concrete road-risk and safety-analysis resource. The metadata do not state a record count or establish equal reporting coverage across the full title interval. Injury and behavioural fields are described without inspecting any individual records. Access is restricted and no file descriptors are exposed, so format, field completeness and record values remain unknown. The named source creators provide this metadata through Zenodo, whose deposits declare CC BY 4.0. Access restrictions and underlying provider terms remain separate from that declaration; cost is unknown unless explicitly stated. Geographic and temporal coverage are limited to the source-described roads, scenarios or periods. Metadata only was reviewed, with no files, measurements, imagery, archives or document bodies downloaded. Related components retain their distinct native identities and possible overlap. The described physical assets, observations or simulator outputs support road infrastructure simulation within these stated limits.
